subject: MATHEMATICS

sibling_handoff.reason: #345 is based directly on #323; this work is stacked on #351. PR323/ remains the authority for topic-by-topic artifact state, NCERT source authority and the binary bundle.

items.name: MathExpression semantic typesetting
items.evidence: AST + Unicode target + measure-then-draw typesetter with real fraction rules, radical overbars and raised scripts; rendered-PDF inspection proves √72 = 6√2 and ℕ ⊂ W ⊂ ℤ ⊂ ℚ ⊂ ℝ survive and that scripts are geometrically raised.
items.open: The #323 renderer's ascii_safe() path still exists and is still used by Publication/engine/realize_math_core_products.py; Core1A output still goes through its own safe_text().

items.name: LearnerMathematicalRealization layer
items.evidence: Shared route-state object {role, input_state, operation, output_state, why_valid}; four topics realized as actual mathematics with real substitutions; cross-item transplant check.
items.relationship_to_351: COMPLEMENTARY. #351's LearnerProduct contract orders the stages (LP-11/12/13 AUTHOR_STAGED_HELP / AUTHOR_THINK_IT_THROUGH / AUTHOR_FULL_WORKING) and its golden theory-of-equations fixture is explicitly a process fixture carrying no worked mathematics; STAGE_RUNNERS is empty. This item defines what counts as realized mathematics inside those stages.
items.open: Not yet wired into STAGE_RUNNERS; no end-to-end learner PDF produced through the whole stack.

items.name: Source / atomic-ask reconciliation ledger
items.evidence: Frozen manifest with required_question_refs AND required_atomic_ask_refs derived from the corpus; rendered witness proving presence, non-occlusion, non-clipping and text extractability on a real PDF.
items.open: Runs against a 4-row / 12-ask source-shape probe, not against the full seven-topic frozen corpora, which live in #345's artifact bundle.

items.name: Spatial representation semantics
items.evidence: COORDINATE_PLANE / NUMBER_LINE / ANGLE_FIGURE declare domain, ticks, origin, axis direction, coordinates, angle-pair identity and parallel-fact status; representation_plan separates givens from learner_must_supply; declared relations are evaluated against declared coordinates.
items.open: No SOLID / surface-selection primitive yet, so the Surface Areas & Volumes class of figure is not covered.

items.name: Equivalence-transformation witness + information sufficiency
items.evidence: {operation, before_relation, after_relation, preserved_invariant, precondition, reversible} with a required extraneous-root check for non-reversible moves; CHECK_SUFFICIENCY carrying UNIQUE/MULTIPLE/UNDERDETERMINED/INCONSISTENT.
items.open: Invariant preservation is asserted and witnessed, not computed. The engine checks that a witness exists, is preconditioned and actually changes the relation; it does not symbolically verify that the solution set is preserved.

items.name: Core1 reconstruction-chain depth and cross-core bridge
items.evidence: Full chain realized in order with RECONSTRUCT carrying a real derivation and practice stages carrying materialized realizations that are re-validated through the item-2 gate; theorem direction first-class; teaching evidence derived, never declared; state-level cross-core linkage with an empty unresolved set.
items.open: Two lessons, not the seven-topic corpus. The bridge is exercised over three rows.

items.name: Typography + layout-safety contract
items.evidence: Minimum readable size per semantic role; pairwise sibling collision with container awareness; measured-vs-allocated overflow; workspace per response mode; measure_then_pack() for solution pages.
items.open: Audits an object map, and the two committed probes are the only renderers that emit one. #323's Publication renderer does not yet emit a math-rendered-object-map.

items.name: Answer custody
items.evidence: Final answer, quick check and independent verification kept as three distinct objects; per-kind obligations for PROOF, CONSTRUCTION, MULTIPLE_VALID, OPEN_RESPONSE and COUNTEREXAMPLE; attempt surface checked against the answer strings.
items.vocabulary_alignment: LEARNER_QUESTION_WITHOUT_ANSWER and SELF_CHECK_SUBSTITUTED_FOR_ANSWER kept as named in issue #358 so #353 (Physics) and #356 (Chemistry) can share the pattern.
items.open: Custody is validated per realization; no Core2 appendix has been generated and checked end to end.

items.name: Kid-appropriate learner copy
items.what_351_already_had: A real, more comprehensive central policy than the issue asked for: approved public labels (TRY IT FIRST, SMALL CLUE, BIGGER CLUE, HOW DO I START?, THINK IT THROUGH, FULL WORKING, QUICK CHECK, WHERE THIS QUESTION CAME FROM) and a forbidden-internal-terms list, bound by policy id in run_learner_product.py.
genuine_gap_closed: No engine scanned text against it: run_learner_product.py checks the policy BINDING only and STAGE_RUNNERS is empty. learner_copy.py is that detector and reads the policy as its authority.

A bare internal ROLE label (RECONSTRUCT, CONTRAST, VERIFY) is not matched by a substring ban-list. forbidden_learner_role_labels, internal_role_label_public_titles, internal_identifier_patterns and role_label_detection were added to that policy file in place, keeping policy_id MATH-LEARNER-LANGUAGE-v1 so the binding check still resolves.
items.no_parallel_registry: LearnerRealization/registry/math-learner-copy-registry.json holds no ban-list. It carries consumer bindings plus the eight legacy tokens Core1A enforced before the policy existed, unioned so adoption can only widen coverage.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: A real worked instance renders proper math typesetting and demonstrates the actual substitution, for at least two of the seven stress-tested topics
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: Number Systems (conjugate rationalisation of 1⁄(√7 − 2)) and Polynomials (factor theorem with p(2) evaluated, then fully factorised), both with substitution nodes and no ASCII flattening.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: Source completeness is checked at both the question and atomic-ask level, and survives to the rendered page
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: 4 rows / 12 atomic asks reconciled and witnessed on a real rendered PDF, with occlusion, clipping and text-extractability gates firing on mutation.
exit_gate_assessment.caveat: Probe corpus, not the seven-topic frozen corpora.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: At least one spatial-representation item proves learner_must_supply separation from givens
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: COORDINATE_PLANE attempt surface declares givens A, B and learner target M, with M unplotted; the SOLUTION surface for the same item plots M and asserts MIDPOINT_OF and EQUIDISTANT_FROM_FIRST.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: At least one algebraic-transformation chain carries an explicit invariant witness
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: Nine witnesses across the reference corpus, including a SOLUTION_SET-preserving SUBTRACT_FROM_BOTH_SIDES in the Linear Equations item.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: Core1 reconstruction-chain falsifiers are real and exercised
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: 33 tests; CORE1_RECONSTRUCTION_WITHOUT_DERIVATION, CORE1_WORKED_INSTANCE_NOT_MATERIALIZED, CORE1_TRANSFER_INSTANCE_MISSING, CORE1_CHAIN_ORDER_DRIFT and CORE1_CORE2_REASONING_COVERAGE_GAP each fired on a single mutation.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: No learner-facing question lacks an answer artifact
exit_gate_assessment.caveat: Every realization in the corpus has custody. No claim is made about Core1A's or Core2's full question inventories, which do not yet flow through this layer.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: No internal role/jargon label appears on a rendered learner page
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: The detector enforces the central policy across CORE1A, CORE2A and LEARNER_REALIZATION, and Core1A now fails closed on role labels and identifiers. Its real cold-start -> Core1A PDF chain passes.
exit_gate_assessment.caveat: Core2A has no engine yet, so its learner pages cannot be scanned; the gate exists and is unexercised there.

exit_gate_assessment.gate: A handoff is left extending #345, not forking it
exit_gate_assessment.evidence: This directory is a sibling under StressTestArtifacts/, points at PR323/ as read-first, and explicitly supersedes nothing in it.

known_open: Three of the seven stress-tested topics (Euclid's Geometry, Lines & Angles, Surface Areas & Volumes) have no realized learner mathematics in this work; they appear only as shapes in the source-ledger probe.
No SOLID / surface-selection spatial primitive, so SOLID_SURFACE_SELECTION_MISMATCH from the consolidated review is not implemented.
LearnerProduct STAGE_RUNNERS remains empty; none of these phases is invoked by the ordered pipeline yet.
Publication/engine/realize_math_core_products.py still defines and uses ascii_safe(); it was not removed, because removing it would change #323's rendered product without a replacement renderer.
Core1A worked examples are not emitted through MathTypesetting.
Equivalence invariants are witnessed and preconditioned, not symbolically verified.
No end-to-end learner PDF has been produced through the full new stack; rendered evidence comes from two purpose-built probes.

ci_also_proves: every committed fixture regenerates byte-identically (git diff --exit-code)
an audit bundle is emitted and uploaded
